about_the_game:
Step up to the ultimate test of skill with the "Master Level '25'" DLC for World of Art – Learn with Jigsaw Puzzles. Designed for experienced puzzle enthusiasts, this advanced collection offers a more demanding and rewarding jigsaw experience. Each puzzle features rich detail, complex textures, and intricate compositions that will challenge even the most seasoned players.

This DLC includes a curated selection of masterpieces from world-renowned artists such as Renoir, Baltens, Matejko, Signac, Shirô, Mauve, Twatchman, Manet, Hassam, Canaletto, Sisley, Købke, Cock, Daubigny, Luce, and many others.

Whether you’re driven by precision, patience, or the satisfaction of solving a truly challenging puzzle, Master Level '25' invites you to push your limits while immersing yourself in great works of art.

Follow the game, add this DLC to your wishlist, and let us know what you think. Your input is invaluable as we continue to build and refine this artistic puzzle experience.
